title: Nickel-catalyzed CNTs enhancing cycle performance of Si@C anodes
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,25485-25494
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA01911K, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Zheng Wang, Shuling Liu, Ming Li, Bo Sun, Hao Li, Haocheng Wen, Haoqi Li, Wenyu Liu, Ruotong Liu, Dongzhu Liu, Aoxiang Kou, Xifei Li
Nickel induces directional CNT growth to build a 3D conductive network. Combined with outer dense carbon coating, they form micro/nano core–shell structures that dissipate mechanical stress and suppress silicon anode volume expansion upon cycling.
